transforms.effect: If options.model is set, adopt publishes model:updated intent configured. The transcript normalizer does not read a model. The monitor batch does not upsert model.

applicability.notes: The declaration says the configured model is known and the transcript does not report the effective model. That matches. There is no display name and no observed intent.
